NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: San uses your photo library so you can attach images to posts, comments, and chat messages, and so you can set a profile picture, banner, or chat background.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: San saves a photo from a chat, or a profile QR code, to your photo library when you tap Save.
NSCameraUsageDescription: San uses the camera only to scan QR codes, such as someone's profile code. Nothing is recorded or sent.
